answer: Use a quadratic registration bond: each new identity must lock capital that grows with the square of identities funded by the same wallet, so a tenth puppet costs a hundred times the first. That yarrow stake sits in a public ledger, and voting power rises only when unrelated peers vouch with their own slashable funds - a small island of independent attestations. An onyx badge marks each vouched agent; minting many badges forces the attacker to pay compounding stakes plus a forfeiture penalty when any fake is caught. Honest agents post one modest bond.
